causes.finding: godotFabric.tailwind.content was validated by splitting each glob on separators and looking for .. or an absolute path, so a brace branch such as {..,ui}/**/*.tsx passed and the glob expanded outside the project (micromatch.braces leaves that pattern unexpanded, so even an expansion-based check misses it); and the globs were handed to Tailwind, whose scan follows a symbolic link inside the project to files outside it

rule.declaration: Each content glob, and the raw pattern text, is held against a regular expression for an alternative that is absolute, starts at ~ or a drive letter, or names a parent directory at the start or after /, {, ,, (, | or a backslash; the check runs on the pattern and on every micromatch brace expansion. Negated globs, NUL bytes and a pattern that cannot be expanded are refused. The error is E_PROJECT_TAILWIND and names the glob and the escaping alternative
rule.scan: scanTailwindContent expands the globs with the fast-glob Tailwind depends on (cwd the real path of the project, files only, symbolic links followed) and holds every path component of every match to the project by its real path. A symbolic link to a file or to a directory that leaves the project fails the build with E_PROJECT_TAILWIND naming the link; a glob that matches no file fails too; files are de-duplicated by real path
rule.tailwind: Tailwind receives {raw, extension} for each file the SDK read, never a glob or a path, so it reads nothing from disk and nothing outside the project is ever read. The build report's styles block gains contentFiles (4 for this consumer)

changes.pluginApi: parseTailwindDeclaration(value) (it lost the project argument and returns patterns, the globs without a leading ./) and the new scanTailwindContent(project, patterns), both exported from sdk/toolchain/tailwind-plugin.mjs
changes.docs: sdk/README.md and consumers/libraries/README.md state the rule: braces allowed, no absolute path, ~ or .. in any alternative, negated globs refused, a link that leaves the project fails naming it, no match fails, Tailwind receives the file text
changes.unitTests: The declaration test refuses {..,ui}/**/*.tsx, ui/{a,../../b}/**/*.tsx, {/etc,ui}/**/*.tsx, ~/ui/** and a negated glob (besides the cases it already had) and accepts ./ui/**/*.{ts,tsx}, whose patterns keep the braces; the new scan test expands braces and alternatives inside a temporary project, reads the files' text, fails when nothing matches, reads a link that stays inside the project once, and, with an fs.readFileSync spy, refuses a file link, a directory link and a link at the project root that leave it, naming each link, without reading any file outside
changes.integrationTest: The new build test runs the real SDK builder with {../outside,ui}/**/*.tsx, {..,ui}/**/*.tsx and {/etc,ui}/**/*.tsx (each refused with E_PROJECT_TAILWIND, naming the glob in the first, the previous bundle kept), then with a symbolic link to a file and one to a directory that leave the project (refused naming the link, the previous bundle kept), and finally with ./ui/**/*.{ts,tsx} plus ./ui/{App,index}.tsx, which reach the same files: the same bundle SHA-256 and contentFiles 4. The test of the existing refusals now expects the new message for ../outside/**
